proposal.summary: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3 due to improperly set ACLs, allowing excessive privileges to users.
proposal.affected_product: CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3
proposal.cwe_quote: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.

AV.quote: ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed.

PR.quote: therefore a wide range of privileges is permitted to a user of the PC where the affected product is installed.

C.quote: the user may be able to destroy the system and/or execute a malicious program.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Review and correct the ACL settings for the affected product installation folder.

evidence_quotes.claim: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource
evidence_quotes.quote: Incorrect permission assignment for critical resource exists in CONPROSYS HMI System (CHS) versions prior to 3.5.3.
ACL (Access Control List) is not appropriately set to the local folder where the affected product is installed.
